name: Stem Picks
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Native playable browser shortcut plus regular-track harmonic ideas and stem recipe guidance.
description: Emulator preview. STEM PICKS opens the current native browser; use its BPM + KEY + MASTER Track Filter and LOAD 1-4. Filtering must be configured and enabled first; the shortcut preserves current category/filter state. Custom Mod Menu suggestions are read-only harmonic ideas for regular tracks, with stem recipe guidance. Vocal titles is an optional title-text filter, not vocal detection. Stem readiness of library results is unknown. Use the deck pads yourself; this mod does not mute stems. Library keys do not follow Key Shift.
